scripts.gen: node gen/genTypes.mjs && node gen/genPTA.mjs && node gen/genPassFlags.mjs
scripts.build: cmake-js clean && cmake-js build && echo 'module.exports = require("./build/Release/iridiumForge.node");' > forge.cjs
scripts.dev: cmake-js clean && cmake-js build --debug --CDDEBUG_FLAGS="$npm_package_config_info" && echo 'module.exports = require("./build/Debug/iridiumForge.node");' > forge.cjs
scripts.dev-dump: cmake-js clean && cmake-js build --debug --CDDEBUG_FLAGS="$npm_package_config_info;$npm_package_config_dump"  && echo 'module.exports = require("./build/Debug/iridiumForge.node");' > forge.cjs
